tagline: Your whole day, in one place
brief: A private life dashboard for one person: planning, tasks, health, money, relationships and notes. It should feel calm, private and whole, and belong with the app's dark forest and lime Drift look.
criteria: Success: not another blue productivity mark or ring with a moon, reads at 16 px with a small-size cut, works in one colour, feels native to the Drift design.

concepts.name: Trail
concepts.idea: A single stroke swells from tail to head: your day gathering weight toward now.
rationale: Echoes the progress ring already in the app
Keeps the idea of an orbit without the usual ring and moon
The round head repeats as the i-dot in the wordmark

recommendation: Trail: the most ownable of the three, and the closest to how the app already looks.
next_steps: Replace the old blue app icon
Add the web icons wherever a web page is served
Commission a trademark search before any commercial launch
